patch.value: Release gates documentation and real-data proof
Exact 100 percent four-dimension source coverage; npm Bun npx bunx packed acceptance; real fleet and physical receipts; allowlisted artifact and gated release workflow

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Public proof: 47 exact published claims reproduced, 53 quantities including separately labelled controls and derivations, 6 incompatible comparisons and 2 unsafe sums refused, 1 unknown cached-subset ratio disclosed. Ten-claim packet is 12382 bytes and 3096 estimated tokens versus 290636 raw source bytes and 72659 tokens. Actual measurement windows remain explicitly unknown; public receipt timestamps are retained. Report details and exact source pins are in docs/real-data.md.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Packed acceptance passed: one captured allowlisted tarball installed in fresh npm and Bun projects; native TOON/JSON help and contracts, successful and refused mutations, SDK reads and writes, npx and native bunx, Node 22.19 and Node 26.13, and no Git executable on PATH. The prior full coverage run passed 59 tests with 538/538 statements, 377/377 branches, 103/103 functions and 487/487 lines. Final source gate follows the adapter and native-remedy refinements.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PR 4 round 1 verified all 12 complete unresolved threads and the one open CodeQL test alert; latest CodeRabbit review has no outside-diff findings. Fixed remaining-page omission counts (bVXy), duplicate limit transports (bVX7), specific provenance union capacity refusals with no mutation (bVYA), exact private-name boundaries (bVYD), reviewable per-claim refresh excerpts (bVYI), explicit pair identity and rule semantics (bVYM), checkout-relative execution (bVXu and bVYW), single-runtime receipt scope (bVXi), and exact NASA hostname parsing (bOOM and bVYc). Packed acceptance now documents POSIX and Bun prerequisites and refuses missing proof before setup (bVYS); deliberately did not adopt skipping because release evidence must not be silently absent. Self-review also fixed whitespace erasure inside guard path literals. Targeted suite passed 21 of 21; linked prerequisite test passed 1 of 1, manually recorded because result tracking is disabled. All 12 new disposable behavioral reversions failed for their expected assertions and the unchanged implementation passed. Independently replacing each entire prior quantityPacket, runCommand and evaluate function also failed its regression, then passed after restoration. The disposable proof harness now copies the authored source inventory needed by the foreign-directory scenario. Typecheck, lint, zero-duplication and docstring gates pass. Refreshed all 47 original claims without changing values or source pins; emitted 47 bounded review excerpts, added explicit pair roles, and retained 53 quantities and 8 refusals. Npm and Bun full release gates will run serially at the final committed head, as prior measured gate duration is comfortably under one hour. No thread replies, resolution or reviewer mentions were sent.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Owned review-loop follow-up fixes PRRT_kwDOVk5Fqc60dqIU and PRRT_kwDOVk5Fqc60dqIl. RationalSchema now rejects all-zero denominators with a string-only regex; malformed text no longer reaches BigInt in a continuable Zod refinement. Direct schema safeParse, pure arithmetic, real SDK writes and the CLI harness reject malformed denominators with invalid_input; the native owner revision and history remain unchanged, and leading-zero positive denominators still normalize correctly. The shared DAG test now observes row.operands: 22 actual derived-node visits plus 21 witness copies, for 43 reads. Restoring the exact prior denominator check fails the new typed-error regression; removing the traversal memo fails the corrected visit counter; restored implementations pass in both disposable proofs. Same-class scans found no remaining BigInt refinements or other misleading quantity-getter counters. Simplified the corpus text guards to standard whole-input anchors while retaining newline and wrong-type tests. Focused core, command and edge tests pass 24 of 24; linked malformed-input test passes 1 of 1 (tracking disabled, results recorded here). Packed npm and Bun journeys including both malformed denominators pass 1 of 1 in 187973 ms without a timeout. The regenerated public receipt reproduces 47 of 47 claims, retains 53 quantities and 8 refusals, and measures 29686 ms on its recorded runtime. Typecheck, lint, zero duplication and docstring checks pass. The final release gate includes 32 safeguard removals and rechecks the unchanged DAG implementation. Run both full gates on the committed head, then batch thread replies and votes and queue the next review after green CI.
